scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/client
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/manager/install.test.mjs tests/android/android-key.test.mjs tests/manager/setup.test.mjs tests/manager/launcher.test.mjs tests/manager/manager-migrations.test.mjs tests/manager/check-update.test.mjs tests/manager/terminal-ui.test.mjs tests/certificates/certbot.test.mjs && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/client
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build -w apps/client && node tools/android/prepare.mjs
